scripts.build: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @sdoc/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sdoc/web build && pnpm build:api
scripts.build:api: uv --directory apps/api run python -m compileall -q app
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @sdoc/contracts lint && pnpm --filter @sdoc/web lint && uv --directory apps/api run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sdoc/contracts test && pnpm --filter @sdoc/web test && uv --directory apps/api run pytest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @sdoc/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @sdoc/web typecheck && uv --directory apps/api run mypy
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
